forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, teams completed 2 visits and 2 clearances. ECV-Z19 was declared free, bringing the total declared free to 11 zones; 31 areas have been released and 15 cleared so far.

The access feed shows 12 zones closed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. The report checker queried 1 report and held 0; 0 dossiers were held. No new plan was approved. Rain or wind accounted for 17 lost team-days.

The forecast made in week 45, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting work already done, gives a P10 to P90 range of 11 to 13 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 11 zones declared free this season.
